decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i0: exact NL3 endpoint contract, source transitions tr_0001 and tr_0002, precise closed-model binding, complete transition inventory, and S2 receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL3 clause requires the system to enter HumanDriving on Power_On. The exact binding identifies the required source as the closed-model system owner and the target as HumanDriving. The complete model inventory instead contains an initial edge to HumanDriving and a Power_On transition from HumanDriving to Autonomous, with no system-to-HumanDriving transition. The possible enclosing-machine reading of system is expressly not resolved by any supplied equivalence, so it is not a competent surviving alternative.
decisions.violated_obligation: A Power_On transition must connect the required system source to HumanDriving.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i1: exact NL4 endpoint contract, precise source and target bindings, source transition tr_0007, closed-model transition line 19, and the supplied unsupported-predicate receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL4 clause requires a transition from system to Autonomous under the front-distance condition. The exact model facts show the corresponding transition from HumanDriving to Autonomous on Front_Distance_10_2, and no transition with source system and target Autonomous. The lack of an executable predicate does not alter the precise semantic comparison. The supplied enclosing-machine shorthand is not supported by an equivalence mapping, so it does not survive.
decisions.violated_obligation: A front-distance condition must produce a transition from the required system source to Autonomous.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i2: exact NL4.2 endpoint contract, source transition tr_0005, precise bindings for AutonomousFinal and HumanDriving, closed transition line 17, and S2 receipt.
decisions.reason: The NL4.2 clause requires a transition to HumanDriving from the system in the Auto Final context, triggered by Human_Steering_Cmd with the stated brake and final-state condition. The exact carrier is AutonomousActive to HumanDriving on Human_Steering_Cmd with no guard, and no system-sourced transition with the required combined condition exists. A separate brake-triggered transition and the shared target do not supply the missing scoped relation. The enclosing-scope interpretation is not backed by a supplied equivalence.
decisions.violated_obligation: The required Auto Final, trigger, brake, and target relation must be represented by a transition to HumanDriving.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i4: NL5 termination contract, exact AutonomousFinal and Power_Off bindings, reachability and zero-outgoing facts, and the supplied unsupported-predicate receipt.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i8: NL5 termination contract, exact Power_Off edge to AutonomousFinal, reachability and zero-outgoing facts, and the supplied unsupported-predicate receipt.

decisions.basis: Dossier 0010:r1:i9: exact V4 binding for AutonomousFinal, NL5 source clause, finite reachability and outgoing-transition facts, source certificate, and completed FBMCQ receipt.
